description: Register an EOA address with the Splits backend so it can be attached to smart accounts as a signer. Idempotent — re-running with the same address returns the same id (and preserves the first name). The returned id is what `splits accounts update-signers --add-eoa-signer-ids` expects. The address is attributed to the user that owns the API key; you cannot register an address on behalf of another user. A registered EOA counts toward threshold identically to a passkey.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this signer. First name wins — re-registering with a different name keeps the original.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: auth_register-signer
